title: Comprehensive molecular impact mapping of common and rare variants at GWAS loci
summary: PMC labels this bioRxiv Version 1, posted 2025-06-06. Results identify DNACipher/DVIM as the sequence-to-function model and variant-prioritization method; T1D credible sets shrink from mean 24 to 1.4 variants and predictions are supported by single-nucleus ATAC-seq and luciferase assays. This is a preprint, not a peer-reviewed publication.
